subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp land this narrow all-unmentioned `suppressTyping` mitigation after rebase, or should the broader visible-delivery typing boundary be the canonical fix?
rationale: Both paths can prevent false WhatsApp typing indicators, but tests cannot decide the user-visible tradeoff where proactive unmentioned visible replies lose their typing flash, and the broader path expands plugin-facing lifecycle API.

options.title: Rebase the narrow mitigation
options.body: Refresh this PR onto current main, adapt the predicate to `conversationKind` plus current group mention metadata, and preserve the command carve-out.

options.title: Use the visible-delivery design
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 as the canonical path only after its conflicts and plugin/API compatibility risks are resolved.

options.title: Keep current behavior for now
options.body: Leave automatic unmentioned group turns with the current typing behavior until a maintainer decides the false-positive typing signal outweighs the proactive-reply typing flash.

recommendation.title: Rebase the narrow mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR onto current main, adapt the predicate to `conversationKind` plus current group mention metadata, and preserve the command carve-out.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping visible-delivery typing PR and has recent merged history in the WhatsApp inbound dispatch area.
